verdict.rationale: Segment's own docs establish a large documented destination catalog (700+ apps, 550+ destinations, catalog entries such as HubSpot and Salesforce Marketing Cloud Actions destinations) and the 'track once, send everywhere' routing model. Nothing in the pack documents per-destination field mapping or per-destination event filtering; the 'Actions' labels only imply mapping, and Functions are a build-it-yourself building block that earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented per-destination mapping, documented per-destination filtering, independent or hands-on corroboration of routing behavior.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can route events to a large catalog of documented destination integrations with per-destination mapping and filtering

citations.quote: activating it across 550+ destinations, including email, messaging, and data warehouses
